rules.rule: No colour outside the six palette hexes for type, grounds, panels, rules, chart marks, icons or recovered act wordmarks.
Pitch, Bone White and Sodium (for every date line) are mandatory palette colours.
Grounds and panels are Pitch or Ash and nothing else.
Pitch is the main ground of every poster, post and deck page.
Every act name is Bone White.
Pitch is always the ground under an act block: every act name sits on Pitch.
Each act name has its date line directly above it.
Every date line is Sodium #E4863B.
Every other line of type (titles, headings, support, door, set, body, billing, table and fine print) is Bone White.
Cold Signal and Blood are used only for hairline rules, dividers, chart marks or a photograph's treatment, never type, a ground or a panel.
Cold Signal and Blood together cover no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area.
Supplied production act wordmarks are recoloured to Bone White, in one solid palette colour.
